data.professional_title: ENGINEERING MANAGER | CLOUDOPS | DEVOPS | SRE | CI/CD
data.summary: Engineering Leader with 15+ years in CloudOps, DevOps, and, SRE, leading teams of up to 40+ engineers and delivering 99.99% uptime for global SaaS platforms. Proven record in multi-cloud architecture, automation, and large-scale distributed systems, delivering 30% cost savings and accelerating release cycles from weeks to hours. Proven 8-year track record in engineering leadership, delivering large-scale cloud and automation initiatives with measurable business impact. Extensive expertise in DevOps practices and SRE principles, delivering high-availability, resilient, and scalable systems. Proficient in multi-cloud environments including AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud, with hands-on experience in architecture, migration, and optimization. Skilled in DevOps toolchains such as Git/GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes for CI/CD automation and container orchestration. Experienced in enterprise monitoring and observability solutions including Datadog, AppDynamics, Prometheus, and Zabbix for proactive incident prevention. Recognized trainer and mentor in Oracle WebLogic, Cloud, and DevOps, enabling team upskilling and knowledge transfer across global teams. Strong leadership in strategic planning and governance, driving enterprise cloud strategy, IT compliance, stakeholder alignment, and global delivery excellence.

responsibilities: Develop, maintain and administer tools which will automate operational activities and improve engineering productivity.
Mentored and upskilled team of 35+ engineers across DevOps, SRE and Cloud adoption.
Developing configuration and infrastructure solutions for internal deployments.
Working with Kubernetes/Docker containers.
Manage systems on OCI infrastructure including application servers, database servers.
Researched and resolved complex issues discovered during Migrations.
Manage high availability of existing systems and proactively address system maintenance issues.
Manage OCI infrastructure configurations along with Application Load Balancers, HTTPS configuration.
Managing 50+ Linux servers & component provisioning & handling configuration & deployment of infrastructure & services.
Managed the infrastructure, avoided single point of failure, monitored RAM CPU space Virtualisation & Load Balancing.
Created server & components by application of Virtualisation Concept using Docker.
Employed HAProxy to conduct load balancing for handling a constantly increasing user base & ensuring scalability & reliability Cloud Based Distributed Computing.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines across diverse tech stacks, enabling zero-downtime deployments and cutting release cycles from weeks to hours.
Pioneered Infrastructure-as-Code adoption with Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes Operators, accelerating infrastructure provisioning by 70%.
Drove DevOps practices embedding security scanning, compliance checks, and automated rollbacks into every build and release pipeline.
Day to day operation of WebLogic platforms like restart, monitoring, etc.
Deployment of applications into servers.
Apache-Web Logic plugins configurations.
24X7 support provided for the infrastructure of Prod/DR/PRE-PROD.
Installation of WebLogic server and Apache web servers.
Communicating with the client, Testing Team & Development Team.
Configuring WebLogic resources like JDBC data source, connection pool.
Fine tuning of various application/web server environments.
Performed root cause analysis and implemented corrective actions.
Designed and incorporated process design improvements.
Troubleshot issues with websites and fixed scripting and use issues.
Proved successful working within tight deadlines and fast-paced atmosphere.
Carried out day-day-day duties accurately and efficiently.

projects.name: ORACLE – GLOBAL BUSINESS UNIT – SAAS APPLICATIONS
projects.description: Scaled multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure/OCI) for 2M+ users, achieving 99.99% SLA via HA architectures and AI-driven observability. Led OCI migration of 30+ client environments, delivering seamless transition with <2 hours downtime and ensuring full compliance with security and performance SLAs. Designed autoscaling policies for Kubernetes clusters handling 2B+ daily API calls.
